posts.title: Ryan BM | Too Hot to Hike #1
posts.description: Sometimes it's too hot to hike. This was probably one of those times. I had no control over the weather when I'd planned the trip that would deliver the Tacoma back to Las Vegas for the winter, but when I found out it was going to be over 100°F both of the days I'd be in Death Valley, I didn't contemplate changing my itinerary, but I did start to noodle on my options for staying cool during the day. "Cool." I arrived at the western entrance to Death Valley National Park just as the sun was setting. What a way…

posts.title: Surprise at Gable Lakes | Southern Summits #2
posts.description: When I'd gone to bed at 8:45pm, I'd planned to make the next day a rest day. After all, I'd just climbed more than 6,250 feet - over the course of just more than 4.5 miles - to summit Mt. Tom. A nice view while I was brushing my teeth. Knowing that the moon was due out around midnight, I figured it couldn't hurt to set my alarm and pop out of the tent for a few photos as it illuminated the Pine Creek valley around my camp. After all, I could make up any lost sleep as the sun…

posts.title: What Happened to My Backup Lights? (Diode Dynamics C2R)
posts.description: TL;DR - Just as I took the Tacoma south for the winter, I noticed that my (new Diode Dynamics C2R) back up lights were not working. Sort of. A distinct lack of light out of the C2Rs. I was in camp on my Southern Summits trip - the trip where I was taking the Tacoma south to Las Vegas for the winter - when I noticed that the area behind the truck wasn't illuminated when I was in reverse. That was super strange because I'd just installed brand new, super bright Diode Dynamics C2R lights that act as white floods…
